content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kanpur Project Manager Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Manager (Q2) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications for the IIT Kanpur Project Manager (Q2) recruitment is 12th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager (Q2) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Manager (Q2) position in the IIT Kanpur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Manager (Q2) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a Master of Law (LL.M.) with 8 years of experience, or a Bachelor of Law with 15 years of experience, or CA/ICWA/CS with 2 years of supervisory experience in a relevant organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Manager (Q2) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Manager (Q2) post is 45 years. There is also an age relaxation of up to 50 years for IIT Kanpur employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager (Q2) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Manager (Q2) post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 29,000 to Rs. 72,200 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Manager (Q2) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager (Q2) role will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Manager (Q2) position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. In which city and state is this job located?
faq.answer: This job is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Manager (Q2) recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Kanpur or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.
